storyboard.addedInformation: weak: the contrast with the defiant smirk on beats 2-3 shows the missing defiance; 'dirty' rests on the label.

storyboard.claim: If you feel dirty just looking at your ruler, you will never presume to overthrow them.

storyboard.claim: The physical narrative is the cage; and to keep up that terrifying perfection, the Golds can't just be pretty aristocrats.

storyboard.addedInformation: The chains show the Reds held in place by the narrative, not by force.
